mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates indicate tight monetary conditions, which can lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If high FEDFUNDS does not correlate with negative 20-day returns in majority of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rates signal labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rise does not precede negative 20-day returns.
